name: affise-mcp-extension
description: Connect Claude to your Affise affiliate platform for advanced analytics and automation
long_description: This extension enables Claude to interact with your Affise affiliate marketing platform: explore offers, query statistics and conversions, analyse trafficback, manage partners/advertisers, generate tracking links, and run partner-side queries. Both natural-language and structured tool calls are supported.

base_url.title: Affise API URL
base_url.description: Your Affise API base URL (e.g., https://api-<company>.affise.com)

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your Affise API key from account settings
